facts.business: The Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) operates a hospitality ecosystem with a portfolio of 630 hotels across 14 brands including Taj, Vivanta, SeleQtions, Ginger, and others, providing hotel ownership, management, and related services across South Asia and 15 countries.
key_risks: Impairment evaluation of investments in subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates involves significant assumptions and judgement
Regulatory changes from new Labour Codes impacting employee benefit obligations
Disputed claims provisions increasing (₹267.72 crores as at March 31, 2026)
facts.related_party_note: Related party payables of ₹2.03 crores as at March 31, 2026 (₹5.19 crores previous year) included in Other Current Financial Liabilities; Roots Corporation Limited acquired 51% stake in ANK Hotels Private Limited and Pride Hospitality Private Limited; Company acquired 51% equity stake in Sparsh Infratech Private Limited (Atmantan); Company along with subsidiaries ANK and Pride acquired 51% in Brij Hospitality Private Limited; Divested 25.52% stake in Taj GVK Hotels & Resorts Limited
